title: My steam page is out!
author: boroscode
selftext: Hello everyone, i made my first game and will release it 2 weeks later. It's a clicker game where you click the fish to gain bubbles and upgrade your powers. If you are interested please add it to your wishlist!

comments.author: 00_Sidd_00
comments.body: Is it just out now? And if so they why would u release it 2 weeks later? Or atleast what's ur plan for marketing and wishlists?

replies.author: boroscode
replies.body: The steampage is out currently to gain wishlists. I plan on market it on social media and also send a copy of the game to youtubers

replies.author: 00_Sidd_00
replies.body: Do u think 2 weeks is enough time for all that and, actually i checked u can only release it after 30 days anyways... Are u in a hurry (just curious, if ya why?)

replies.author: boroscode
replies.body: I'm not actually sure,  i am just excited to publish my first game, if i don't have enough wishlists i may delay the release date. Also you can release the game  after 2 weeks of steampage release
